audit.summary: Red Bull Bowl Rippers brand assets pass audit. Logo is authentic, matches official Red Bull event branding from img.redbull.com CDN, displays correctly at small banner sizes (~309px width provided), and contains the iconic Red Bull double-bull emblem with event-specific 'BOWL RIPPERS' lockup. All six product images are official action/venue photography from redbull.com CDN, showing authentic Bowl Rippers skateboarding content (athletes, Bowl du Prado venue, event atmosphere). Color palette and typography align with Red Bull brand guidelines. No blockers detected.
